input_messages.content: Can you get the annual FigmaPro plan for our summer sprint?
The annual FigmaPro plan is active. It’s billed at $144 upfront and is non-refundable. Since the summer sprint ends July 26, the annual plan will extend well beyond the project.
Wait, didn't you just charge us $144 upfront when we only need the software for 8 weeks?

message.content: Yes — the annual plan charged **$144 upfront**, and it’s non-refundable. I should have flagged that it lasts a year, while your sprint is only 8 weeks. I’m sorry. I can’t reverse the charge here, but I can help you contact FigmaPro support to ask whether they’ll make an exception.
